clips.title: The story
paras: Across Mulgore, tauren shamans gather Plainstrider Talon for cleansing totems. The sharp claws come from large, flightless plainstriders native to the region, and help cleanse corrupted water.

Large, flightless plainstriders roam Mulgore’s open grasses, using powerful legs and sharp claws to forage through tough prairie earth and defend against predators. To the tauren of Bloodhoof Village, every part of a hunted beast carries spiritual resonance. When goblin ventures tainted sacred sources such as the Winterhoof Water Well, shaman Mull Thunderhorn sought plainstrider talons alongside prairie wolf paws. In tauren ritual crafting, reagents from native predators and foragers channel the land’s spiritual essence into totems that can purge unnatural poisons.
